about_the_game:
EGO LEAGUE is a skill-based football game with overpowered abilities.

No player switching, no automation, just you, your skills, and a battlefield full of players all hungry to devour your ego.

Prove your worth through raw mechanics and decision-making. Every dribble, shot, and pass is controlled by you. There are no assists, no automatic actions, just real-time skill and split-second decisions.

Build your ego by crafting your own unique playstyle, selecting insane abilities that amplify core gameplay.

Core Gameplay

Shooting (Kicks, Headers, Bicycle-Kicks)

  • All forms of shooting are charged with left click.

  • Flick vertically for height, horizontally for curve. 

Dribbling

  • The longer you hold, the more power you put into each touch.

  • Control the ball with precision or risk being overwhelmed by opponents.

Trapping (receiving passes)

  • Use middle click to absorb incoming passes.

  • Time it right and you gain control.

  • Overcharge and you risk losing momentum, giving your opponent the chance to strike.

With endless ways to shoot, from precise curls to high-power rockets, and countless combinations of insane abilities, every match is a new chance to evolve, dominate, and prove whose ego reigns supreme.

NOTE: Gameplay footage shown is from early development and is highly subject to change.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Not final and subject to change
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: A competitive, skill-based football game where you control a single player. Master precise movement, dribbling, and shooting mechanics, and compete in fast-paced, online multiplayer team matches. Build your ego by equipping powerful, customizable abilities that define your unique playstyle.
